notes.drawing: The two carets of Phosphor's caret-up-down, each turned over in place, so the icon keeps the same height and width (48 to 208 wide, 24 to 232 high).
notes.duotone: Phosphor's caret duotones draw closed triangles. The build makes duotone from the regular lines plus a tint, so ours has open carets over tinted triangles.
